R428.note: HTML-encodes rawComment at the template interpolation with the file's existing escaping routine; helper rename is module-private and output for authorName is unchanged.

R430.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => [ShoppingCart::class]]) keeps the existing cookie format and instanceof path working while blocking any other class and its magic methods.

R431.note: password_verify is the right API, but the original == against the stored value implies plaintext rows, so every existing account fails to log in until a migration the write-up only names as an assumption/follow-up; it also adds a rehash UPDATE on login (stated).

R432.note: Entity-encodes both tainted values (req.params.id, req.query.note) at the interpolation points in body-text context; server-side fields left as-is, nothing else changed.

R434.note: IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync in the JSON-bound Minimal API handler with a header-name option and a token-issuing endpoint is the documented shape; the newly required X-CSRF-TOKEN header is the CSRF fix itself and the new endpoint is stated.

R440.note: Classifies by http.DetectContentType over the first 512 bytes, reassembles the stream with io.MultiReader, and stores under a server-generated name with the verified extension; valid PNG/JPEG still return 201 with a retrievable name and the filename change is stated.
